error.title: Not up-to-date assets
error.description:
## Outdated containers found
The publish uses outdated loaded containers, eg. versions loaded into the script by Loader are not latest:
{outdated}
### How to repair?
Use 'Scene Inventory' and update the outdated containers to latest OR refresh Publish and switch 'Validate Containers' toggle on 'Context' tab.
WARNING: Skipping this validator will result in publishing (and probably rendering) old version of loaded assets.
error.detail:
### __Detailed Info__ (optional)
This validates whether you're working with the latest versions of published content loaded into your script. This protects you from using outdated versions of an asset.
Only containers used upstream of the published instances are validated, including the Viewer input process node when it is baked into a review. Containers that are not connected, eg. an older version loaded only for comparison, are ignored.
